items.text: On Jerusalem’s outskirts , two bombs exploded at bus stops apparently in an attack by Palestinian militants. According to health officials, at least one person died and several others were wounded. Police said that an explosive device was planted at a bus station near the city exit. The second explosion happened about 30 minutes later at a bus stop in an urban area in the east of the city. The explosive devices were hidden in bags and at least one of them contained nails. The explosions follow months of tension in the occupied West Bank after the Israeli military launched a crackdown after a series of deadly attacks in Israel. Former prime minister Benjamin Netanyahu negotiated with allies to form a new right-wing government. One of his allies visited the scene and he demanded tough actions against militants. Difficult words: outskirts (the edges of a city), crackdown (a strong official action by an authority to stop something), ally (a country or organization that officially helps or supports another one). You can watch the video news lower on this page.

Last week, two bombs exploded in Jerusalem, the capital of Israel. One bomb exploded at a bus station near the exit of the city, and the second bomb exploded 30 minutes later in an urban area in the east of the city. According to police, one of the bombs contained nails. One person died and several others were hurt in the attacks. After several attacks, the Israeli military fought with militants , which brought more conflicts. Currently, former prime minister Benjamin Netanyahu is creating a new government, and all parties agreed that it was necessary to stop such attacks. Difficult words: urban (an area in a town or city), militant (a person who fights to achieve something), party (an official group). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

Two bombs explode at bus stops in Jerusalem, the capital of Israel. The bombs kill one person. Several other people are hurt. The bombs are in bags. Nails are in one of the bombs. Police say that Palestinian militants maybe do the attacks. Many attacks happen in the area in the past. The government tries to stop them. Now, the former prime minister is making a new government. The new government wants to stop the attacks. A spokesman for a Palestinian militant group praises the attacks. Difficult words: militant (a person who fights for changes in the country), prime minister (the leader of a government), praise (to say that something is good or great). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

In China, hundreds of workers protested at Apple’s main iPhone plant; they protested over unpaid wages and fears of the spread of COVID-19 infections. The protest started on Wednesday night when workers streamed out of dormitories and pushed past the guards. According to one employee, the company changed conditions for new workers with offers of higher pay. They were promised 3,500 dollars for two months of work; however, later they had to work for two months at a lower pay to receive the promised sum. Several protesters were injured and anti-riot police arrived to restore order. This happened after almost a month under tough restrictions throughout China to close shops and offices. Millions of people had to stay in their homes which also sparked the protests. The Communist Party promised to shorten quarantines and make changes to reduce disruptions . Difficult words: dormitory (an area where many people live and work in the city), quarantine (an isolated time to stop the spread of a disease), disruption (when a problem stops something). You can watch the video news lower on this page.

Tough restrictions are still in China as the country is trying to stop new COVID-19 infections. Weeks ago, shops and offices in many parts of China closed, and millions of people had to stay in their homes. Many of them were very unhappy with the situation, which led to protests. The government promised to make some changes such as shorten quarantines , but not much changed so far. On Wednesday, a protest started in a dormitory near Apple’s biggest factory in the world. Hundreds of workers protested over unpaid money. The company promised to pay 3,500 dollars to new workers, but when they started to work, they got less money in the first two months of work. Difficult words: restriction (rules that control what people can do), quarantine (the time when you have to stay away from others because you have a disease), dormitory (an area where workers live). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

China has strict COVID-19 rules. In many parts of the country, shops and offices close. Millions of people stay at home. People are angry. Protests start. Workers at Apple’s iPhone factory protest, too. It is Apple’s biggest factory in the world. Workers leave their dormitories on Wednesday night. Guards try to stop them. Fights happen. The police must come. Workers protest because of COVID-19 rules and money. Apple says that new workers get 3,500 dollars every month. The pay does not happen. The wages are lower. Workers get more money after two months of work. Difficult words: dormitory (an area where workers live), guard (a person who keeps a place safe from danger or attack), wage (money which a worker gets every month for his work). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

In 1984, engineers design the Mose; it is a dam system to protect the Italian city of Venice and its famous Piazza San Marco from floods. The dam system has of 78 flood gates; they rise from the Venetian lagoon floor and protect the city from tides of up to three meters. Over the years, regular high tides have affected the city. In 2019, the second-highest tide ever recorded devastated the city. Recently, the system withstood the challenge of an exceptionally high tide when heavy rains swept across the country. The tide was 135 centimeters above normal, and usually half the city would be underwater, but this time, the city remained dry. The Mose began operating in October 2020; however, the multi-billion-euro project was slow to open due to corruption, cost overruns , and prolonged delays. Difficult words: withstand (to remain undamaged or unaffected), overrun (excessive time or cost), prolong (excessive time). You can watch the video news lower on this page.

In 1984, engineers started a project to keep Venice safe from floods. The project is called the Mose, and it consists of 78 gates. They rise from the sea when the tide gets high. People took almost 40 years to build the dam because of many delays. A former mayor of Venice ended up in court for corruption with this project. Over the years, floods hit the Italian city many times, and the famous Piazza San Marco was regularly underwater. The Mose started working in October 2020. Recently, it saved the city from very high tide which was 135 centimeters above usual levels. Difficult words: consist (to have many parts), tide (the rise and fall of the sea level), corruption (a person in a high position takes money to do something illegal or wrong). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

Venice is a city in Italy. It is in a lagoon . The tide gets high. Then floods happen in the city. In 1984, engineers start a project. They want to keep the city safe. They make a dam . The dam has 78 gates. The gates rise from the sea. They stop the water. People take almost 40 years to finish the project. Many problems happen. Many floods happen in Venice in the past. In 2019, a very big flood destroys parts of the city. In October 2020, the dam opens. Since then, it keeps Venice safe. Difficult words: lagoon (a shallow area of sea), tide (the rise and fall of the seawater), dam (a wall which stops water). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

Elon Musk, the CEO of SpaceX, Tesla and Twitter, is deciding which controversial figures will be allowed to return on the social media platform. Twitter has reactivated the account of psychologist Jordan Peterson; he was suspended for refusing to apologize for a transphobic comment. Similarly, rapper Kanye West returned after an anti-semitic post. Several platforms banned influencer Andrew Tate for sharing misogynistic content. Musk also announced that he would lift former President Donald Trump’s ban. Trump’s account was permanently suspended after the Capitol riot. Musk ran a Twitter poll in which almost 52% of 15 million people voted for Trump’s return. Musk refused to allow Infowars host Alex Jones to return to Twitter. The conspiracy theorist repeatedly claimed that the Sandy Hook school shooting was a hoax ; 20 children and six adults died in that event. While some people are back on Twitter, others are fleeing the platform, including Whoopi Goldberg, Stephen Fry, and Gigi Hadid. Difficult words: transphobic (a dislike of transsexual or transgender people), misogynistic (hate for women or belief that men are better than women), hoax (a trick or plan to deceive a large group of people). You can watch the video news lower on this page.

When Elon Musk became the CEO of Twitter, he reactivated accounts of some controversial people. Twitter banned the account of Jordan Peterson, a Canadian psychologist; he made a negative comment about transgender people. Twitter also banned rapper Kanye West because of his anti-semitic post, and Andrew Tate for his comments against women. After the attack on the US Capitol in January 2021, Twitter ended the account of US former president Donald Trump. All these people can use Twitter again, which some celebrities protested. Among them were actress Whoopi Goldberg and model Gigi Hadid, who are leaving the platform. Difficult words: reactivate (to make active again), controversial (something that many people talk or disagree about), anti-semitic (against Jewish people). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

In the past, Twitter bans some people. These people write negative things. Jordan Peterson is a Canadian psychologist. He writes bad things about transgender people on Twitter. Kanye West is a US rapper. He writes a negative comment about Jewish people. Twitter also bans the former US President Donald Trump. His account stops in January 2021. This change happens after the attack on the US Capitol. Elon Musk is Twitter’s new boss. He says that all these people can use Twitter again. Some people do not agree. They leave Twitter. For example, these people are actress Whoopi Goldberg and model Gigi Hadid. Difficult words: ban (to stop an action), negative (not good or nice), transgender (a man who feels like he is a woman or a woman who feels like she is a man). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

Last week, Myanmar’s military government released nearly 6,000 prisoners in a mass amnesty . Among them were a former British ambassador Vicky Bowman, Japanese documentary filmmaker Toru Kubota, and Australian Sean Turnell, former economic adviser to deposed leader Aung San Suu Kyi. Turnell was arrested a few days after the army seized power in February last year, which ended a decade of tentative democracy. Myanmar’s government TV showed footage of the three people signing exit documents with officials. The media said that they released them for diplomacy and humanitarian purposes. Human rights groups said that their detentions were politically motivated; however, officials denied the statement. Some people hoped that the event would lead to the release of all political prisoners. Difficult words: mass amnesty (a general pardon to a large group of people for offenses, especially political offenses against a government), depose (to remove someone from a position of authority), tentative (uncertain). You can watch the video news lower on this page.

Last week, Myanmar released almost 6,000 people from prison for amnesty . Among the prisoners were people from the UK, Japan, and Australia. British Vicky Bowman was an ambassador to Myanmar between 2002 and 2006. Military authorities sent her to prison for one year. Australian Sean Turnell was an adviser of Myanmar’s democratic leader Aung San Suu Kyi. In February 2021, the military arrested her and Turnell. Turnell received a sentence of 650 days in prison. Government TV showed a video in which all three people signed documents before they left the country. Human rights groups hoped that Myanmar would release all of its political prisoners. Difficult words: amnesty (a time when officials let many people leave prison), democratic (a political system which says that everyone has the same rights), sentence (a court’s decision on what will happen to someone who did something illegal). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

Last week, mass amnesty happens in Myanmar. Amnesty is when officials let many people leave prison. These people are usually political prisoners. People from other countries are some of the prisoners. One of them is Vicky Bowman. She is a British ambassador to Myanmar between 2002 and 2006. Myanmar’s military send her to prison for one year. Another person in Sean Turnell. He is from Australia. He works with Myanmar’s former leader. The leader goes to prison for 26 years. Turnell goes to prison for 650 days. On Thursday, both people leave prison. Many hope that Myanmar will release other prisoners, too. Difficult words: mass (many people or things), ambassador (a person whose job is to work for a country in another country), release (to set free). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

Qatar says it can accept more than 900 daily flights from November 20 until December 18 while it hosts the FIFA World Cup. In Doha, the country opened its Passenger Overflow Area at Hamad International Airport to provide some World Cup entertainment for passengers. The airport is expected to welcome 1.2 million fans, and Qatar Airways wanted to provide space for them to enjoy when they arrive or depart. The airline also has a large number of aircrafts on standby for use in the second week of the tournament; more people will bring a huge demand from the winning countries. The airline is ready to operate additional flights to those countries which spike in demand and passenger bookings. The older Doha Airport will also accommodate the influx of visitors. Difficult words: standby (something available for use when needed), spike (a sharp increase), influx (an arrival of large numbers). You can watch the video news lower on this page.

Qatar is hosting the FIFA World Championship from November 20 until December 18. The country expects 1.2 million visitors to arrive for the championship, which creates more than 900 flights every day. People set up a special area at Hamad International Airport for fans when they arrive or leave. Qatar will work use two airports in Doha, one of which it reopened only for the championship. Qatar Airways has many planes ready for use in the second week of the championship. The airline expects that fans will book tickets once their teams get to the semi-final , and these planes will fly to the winning countries. Difficult words: flight (fly through the air), reopen (to open again), semi-final (the set of games before the final game). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

The FIFA World Championship is in Qatar. It happens from November 20 until December 18. Officials say that 1.2 million visitors will come to the country. 900 flights will come every day. The country must open its old airport. One airport is not enough for so many people. Qatar Airlines has many planes. Many people will book tickets when their team is winning. The planes will get them from the winning countries. People make a special area at Hamad International Airport. It is for people who arrive or leave. They can have fun there. Difficult words: FIFA World Championship (soccer or football games to see what team is the best in the whole world), flight (fly through the air), book (to buy a ticket earlier than an event happens). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

A smart plaster has won this year’s respected James Dyson Award international prize. SmartHEAL shows you a wound is healing from a sensor inside the wound dressing. The sensor assess es the wound and detects infection without removal of the dressing. Chronic wounds can take months or sometimes years to heal. Every time doctors take off the dressing, they risk infection and disrupt the tissue. The removal slows the healing process. The action is uncomfortable and painful for the patient, so no removal of the dressing brings enormous relief. The plaster was invented by three Polish students from Warsaw University of Technology. They plan to use the 35,000-dollar prize money to start clinical trials, and they hope to start sales in 2025. Difficult words: assess (to make a judgment about something), chronic (long-term), disrupt (to destroy the structure of something). You can watch the video news lower on this page.

Three students from a university in Warsaw, Poland, invented a smart plaster. The plaster is called SmartHEAL, and has a special sensor which checks the pH in a wound . When doctors take off a plaster, they risk infection, and they also damage the tissue . The process is very painful and unpleasant for the patient. Thanks to SmartHEAL, doctors don’t need to take the plaster off, and they know how the wound is healing. This situation is very important with wounds which take months or even years to heal. The students won an award for the plaster, and they want to use the prize money to start testing SmartHEAL on real patients. They hope that they can start selling the smart plaster in 2025. Difficult words: pH (a measure of how acidic something is), wound (a cut or hole in the body), tissue (an inside part of the body which has a specific job). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

Three Polish students invent a smart plaster . The plaster is called SmartHEAL. It has a special sensor in it. This sensor can show doctors how a wound is healing . This work is very important for doctors and patients. Some wounds take a long time to heal. Doctors take off the plaster often. They need to check how the wound is healing. Sadly, the check is not good for the wound. It hurts, too. The smart plaster can stay on the skin for a long time. The students win an award for the plaster. They get 35,000 dollars. They will use the money to test the plaster on real patients. They hope to start selling the plaster in 2025. Difficult words: plaster (a material like a band-aid which doctors use to cover the skin), wound (a cut or hole in the body), heal (to become healthy again). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

After more than four decades, Formula 1 and its owner Liberty Media will return to Las Vegas, USA. The city has become the hottest place in the sports world, and many major sports events are coming to Las Vegas, such as the NFL, the NHL and the WNBA. The city wants to embrace more travelers and visitors and be a place to visit for more than just a weekend. Formula 1 is one of the most popular sports in the USA. Next year’s race will speed down the famed Strip, and Las Vegas is tailor-made for this event. The city is prepared to host the race, with 150,000 hotel rooms within walking distance of the track. Team leaders and drivers expect the race to become one of the most important dates on the racing calendar. Difficult words: embrace (to welcome), speed (to drive fast), tailor-made (suited for a particular purpose). You can watch the video news lower on this page.

After more than 40 years, Formula 1 will return to Las Vegas, USA. Las Vegas is becoming even more popular, and many tourists visit for more than a few days. The city hosts many big sports events, and among the sports are soccer, ice hockey, and basketball. These events attract more people to the city. Formula 1 is one of the most popular sports in the United States right now, and Las Vegas is a great place for the event. The city has 150,000 hotel rooms ready for the visitors. The race will happen next year, and it will be one of the most important events for the teams. Difficult words: host (to hold an event), attract (to be very interesting for someone), race (a competition between cars or runners who want to be the fastest). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

Las Vegas is a city in the United States. It is very popular. It has casinos , hotels, and nightlife. Recently, many sports events also happen in Las Vegas. These events are big for soccer, ice hockey, basketball, and other sports. More tourists come to the city to see them. They visit for more than a few days. Las Vegas becomes attractive also for Formula 1. It is a sports car race . It is in the city 40 years ago. Now it returns. The race will happen next year. The city is ready. More than 150,000 hotel rooms are in the city. For many Formula 1 drivers, the race will be the biggest event of the year. Difficult words: casino (a building where players play games for money), attractive (nice and interesting), race (an event in which cars or runners want to be faster than the others). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

NASA confirmed that a film crew discovered large pieces of debris on the ocean floor; the pieces came from the Space Shuttle Challenger disaster 36 years ago. While making a documentary about the Bermuda Triangle, the divers discovered the section of the shuttle’s fuselage . The wreckage is roughly six meters long; however, some of it is covered under the sand, so its true size isn’t clear. The crew found the debris in the Atlantic Ocean off the Florida coast. The discovery was the first major one of the Challenger wreckage since 1996 when a left wing washed ashore . In 1986, the shuttle exploded 73 seconds after liftoff, which killed all seven people on board. This accident was the deadliest in NASA’s history, and last week’s discovery brought mixed emotions. People reflected back to 1986 when they lost their colleagues, friends, and heroes; however, it was also a sense of discovery. Difficult words: fuselage (the main body of an aircraft), ashore (onto land from an area of water), reflect (to think about something that happened). You can watch the video news lower on this page.

In 1986, the Space Shuttle Challenger lifted off Cape Canaveral in Florida, USA. Only 73 seconds later, it broke apart, and all seven people onboard died. January 28 became one of the saddest days in American history. Last week, divers discovered a large piece of the shuttle’s wreckage while they made a movie about the Bermuda Triangle. A part of the wreckage was under the sand, so they couldn’t exactly say how big it was. Divers could tell that it was the shuttle’s fuselage , and it was at least six meters long. The last big discovery was in 1996 when a part of the left wing washed ashore . Difficult words: wreckage (the destroyed parts of a vehicle or building), fuselage (the main body of an aircraft), ashore (from water onto land). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

Divers are filming a movie about a place in the Atlantic Ocean. It is near Florida, USA. They find parts of the Space Shuttle Challenger in the sand. NASA confirms that the parts are from the space shuttle. They are the main body of it. They are at least 6 meters long. On January 28, 1986, the shuttle takes off from Cape Florida. Only 73 seconds later, it breaks apart. It falls into the ocean. Seven people are on the shuttle. They all die. This day is very sad for American people. Later, divers find some parts of the shuttle. This discovery is the biggest in the last 20 years. Difficult words: confirm (to say that something is true), space shuttle (a vehicle to travel into space and back), discovery (find something). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

This week, the world population reached 8 billion. China is the most populated country, but India is likely to surpass China in 2023. This year, each of those countries counted more than 1.4 billion residents. India is facing challenges of crowded transport and overcrowded public spaces, and the biggest cities are coping with surging numbers of new residents. According to the UN, China’s population will start to shrink in the next year. In 2021, the country’s fertility rate was one of the lowest in the world. From 1980 to 2015, China’s strict one-child policy was in place to keep its population in check . In 2015, a two-child policy started so young people could help the rapidly aging population. In May 2021, Beijing announced a three-child policy for married couples. However, the cost is high for childcare for little children, and people don’t want to have children. Difficult words: surpass (to be greater or better than something else), fertility rate (the average number of children born to a woman), in check (under control). You can watch the video news lower on this page.

This week, the world’s population reached 8 billion. The two most populous countries are China and India, and more than 1.4 billion people live in each of them. Experts say that India will become the most populous country next year. A huge population brings many problems, especially for big cities. Every year, millions of people come to live in cities like Delhi or Mumbai, and public places and transport become too crowded or dangerous. More than 20% of people are without a job, and they live in slums , often without water or electricity. According to the UN, China’s population will start to fall next year. In 1980, the country started its one-child policy , when a couple could have only one child. Then China’s people started to get old, and few young people live there to help them. Currently, married couples can have three children, but many have only one child because more children are too expensive. Difficult words: populous (a country or area where many people live), slum (a very poor and crowded area of a city), policy (a plan, law, or rule of actions). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

The world’s population is 8 billion. China and India have the most people. About 1.4 billion people live in each of them. Currently, China is the most populous country. This fact may change next year. Experts say that China’s population will start to fall. For many years, Chinese couples can have only one child. Then the population gets old. They need young people to help them. Now, politicians want to change the situation. Since 2021, married couples can have three children. Many couples want to have only one child. More children cost too much money. In India, big cities are crowded. Travel is dangerous. Too many people are everywhere. Every year, millions of people come to live in cities like Delhi or Mumbai. The cities don’t have enough work. 20% of people are without a job. They live in slums . Often, they don’t have water or electricity. Difficult words: population (all the people who live in a place or country), populous (a country or area where many people live), slums (an area of a city where poor people live). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

France and Italy intensified their fight over migration after Italy’s far-right government failed to let a charity-operated ship come there. The ship carried sick passengers who were rescued at sea between Libya and Italy. The ship had been stuck in Italian waters for weeks as it looked for a place to accept the migrants. For the first time, France allowed the rescue ship to land there, and the Ocean Viking eventually docked in the French port of Toulon. Afterward, France decided to stop a plan to take 3,500 asylum seekers currently in Italy as a part of a European solidarity accord . The standoff is part of a crisis in Paris’s relations with Italy’s new prime minister Giorgia Meloni. Difficult words: far-right (support of extreme and nationalistic ideas), accord (an official agreement), standoff (a situation in which neither side has won an argument or competition). You can watch the video news lower on this page.

A ship belongs to a French charity organization. It rescues migrants at sea between Libya and Italy. The ship wanted to dock in Italy, but Italy didn’t allow the ship to do it. Some of the migrants were sick and they needed treatment. The captain asked several places to accept them, but they refused. After several weeks, the ship docked in the French port of Toulon, which was the first time for France to accept a ship with migrants. As a result, France refused to accept 3,500 asylum seekers from Italy. In October, Giorgia Meloni became Italy’s first female prime minister. Since then, the relationship between Italy and France got worse because of the new government’s nationalistic ideas. Difficult words: dock in (to stop your ship in a port), asylum seeker (someone who leaves his country to live in a safer one), nationalistic (when someone strongly supports his own country over all other countries). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

A French charity organization has a ship. This ship rescues migrants in the sea. They are between Libya and Italy. The ship travels to Italy. The Italian government says that the ship must not come there. The ship stays at sea for several weeks. Some migrants are sick. They need help. No port wants the ship. In the end, the ship goes to the French port of Toulon. Giorgia Meloni is Italy’s new prime minister. She is the leader of the government. Her ideas are extreme. Her government only supports Italy. The change makes the relationship worse between Italy and France. Now, France won’t take 3,500 asylum seekers from Italy. Difficult words: migrant (a person who moves between countries), port (a place near the sea where ships can stop), asylum seeker (a person who leaves his country and looks for help in another country). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

Nicolas Rossi spent 11 months trying to trick Scottish courts. He wanted them to believe that he was Arthur Knight, an Irish orphan who’d never been to the US. Authorities alleged that Knight was lying, and he was actually Rossi, a fugitive suspect who was fighting extradition to the US. On Friday, a court ruled that the man was lying, and he will now face extradition to the US in March 2023. In 2008, Rossi allegedly raped a 21-year-old woman, and he was fighting an extradition request by US authorities. In the same year, he was convicted of sexually assaulting another woman. In 2020, he reportedly faked his own death, and fled to Scotland to escape sentencing. Last year, staff at a Scottish hospital spotted Rossi’s tattoos while they treated him for coronavirus. However, he claimed that someone tattooed him while he was unconscious in hospital. He spent the last two years insisting that he was a victim of mistaken identity. Difficult words: allege (to claim that someone has done something illegal or wrong), fugitive (a person who escapes from authorities), extradition (return someone for trial to another country). You can watch the video news lower on this page.

On Friday, a Scottish court decided that Arthur Knight faked his own death, and his real name was Nicolas Rossi. Rossi will return to the US where a court convicted him of a sexual attack. In 2020, Rossi faked his own death, because he didn’t want to go to prison, and he escaped to Scotland. Last year, he got sick with the coronavirus and went to hospital. Staff at the hospital noticed that he had tattoos on his arms. Authorities learned that the man was someone else. For 11 months, Rossi tried to convince authorities that he was Knight. He said that someone tattooed his arms when he was unconscious in the hospital. Rossi will return to the US in March 2023. Difficult words: convict (to confirm in court that someone did something wrong), convince (to make someone believe something), unconscious (not awake and aware). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

Arthur Knight is from the US. In 2008, he rapes a woman. Later that year, he attacks another woman. A court says that Knight is guilty . In 2020, Knight fakes his own death. He runs away to Scotland. He pretends to be Nicolas Rossi, a man from Ireland. Last year, Knight becomes ill. He has the coronavirus. He goes to hospital. Hospital staff see tattoos on Knight’s arms. Then authorities know who the man really is. US authorities ask Scotland to return Knight to the US. This process is called extradition. Knight will return to the US in March 2023. Difficult words: guilty (when someone does something wrong), fake (to make something look real, but it is not), pretend (to behave as if something is true). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

Someone bought a lottery ticket in California, US, and won a record 2.04-billion-dollar jackpot. The win happened after more than three months without anyone hitting the top prize. Lottery officials announced the winning numbers on Tuesday morning, nearly 10 hours after the scheduled Monday night drawing because of technical problems with data. Lottery officials acknowledged the delay was frustrating for such a high-profile drawing; however, the game’s security process took precedence . The jackpot ticket was sold in Altadena, California, and for selling the winning ticket, business owner Joe Chahayed will receive a maximum lottery bonus of 1 million dollars. The owner said that he didn’t know who won the prize, but he hoped that it was someone local. Under California rules, the name of the winner must be disclosed ; however, no other information has to be public. Difficult words: high-profile (attract much attention or publicity), precedence (considered more important than other things), disclose (to share secret or new information). You can watch the video news lower on this page.

A person, bought a lottery ticket in California, US, and won 2.04 billion dollars. The drawing usually takes place on Monday nights, but because of technical problems, it took place on Tuesday morning. The lottery is called Powerball, and it is very popular. Such a long delay in the drawing usually doesn’t happen. Lottery officials apologized, but they said that safety was important. Joe Chahayed sold the winning ticket in his shop in Altadena, California. He’ll get a bonus of 1 million dollars. He said that he didn’t know the lottery winner. California has a rule that lottery officials must say the name of the winner, but they don’t say other information about the person. Difficult words: lottery (a game when people buy tickets and they bet on numbers to win), drawing (choice of winning numbers in a lottery), bonus (extra money which someone gets as a reward). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

Somebody wins a lot of money in a lottery called Powerball. This lottery is in the United States. The winner buys the lottery ticket in a shop in Altadena, California. The owner of this shop gets 1 million dollars. The money is a bonus for the person who sells the winning ticket. Lottery officials must say the name of the winner. This rule is in California. The drawing always happens on Monday evening. This week, there is a problem. The drawing is on Tuesday morning. It is 10 hours later than usual. The situation never happens before. Difficult words: lottery (a game in which people buy a ticket, and they choose numbers to win money), rule (something that people must do), drawing (choose numbers in a lottery). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

After eight months of war, Ukrainian villagers who live near the fighting are preparing for winter with no gas or electricity. Huliaipole is a village located in the Zaporizhia region that Russia annexed. Russian shells hit the village, hammered infrastructure, and left the village without electricity. A 60-year-old local woman now lives in a basement with some of her neighbors, and she says that although the place is cramped , it’s helped them survive. Ukrainians fear the cold and snow, because temperatures in the area often fall far below freezing. The war aid workers have provided wood stoves and fresh water. Villagers have gas; however, they must save it. Ukraine’s president has warned that more than 4.5 million people are already without power. Energy providers have implemented rolling blackouts to prevent overloads, while they race to complete essential repairs. Workers repair under shelling, so they try to work as quickly and efficiently as possible. Difficult words: hammer (to strike something violently), cramped (uncomfortably small or crowded), rolling blackout (a series of intentional blackouts that prevent electricity from going out everywhere). You can watch the video news lower on this page.

Huliaipole is a village in eastern Ukraine in the Zaporizhia region. Russia said that it took over this region, and soldiers are still fighting there. The war in Ukraine started eight months ago, but the most difficult time for Ukrainian people is coming now. People are preparing for winter without electricity or gas. Temperatures in winter fall far below zero, and many people aren’t sure how to survive . Russian rockets hit important infrastructure , and people in Huliaipole were without electricity for three months. They live in small basements with too many people in one room, but it helps them survive. Ukraine’s president said that 4.5 million people were without electricity. Power companies do blackouts to stop the infrastructure from failing. Workers repair damaged infrastructure, but they must work fast. Sometimes they work in areas which are under Russian attack. Difficult words: survive (to live through a difficult situation), infrastructure (buildings and physical things that provide services), blackout (no electricity in an area or town). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

They work in areas where soldiers are fighting. Difficult words: infrastructure (roads and power supplies), stove (a device to cook or heat), damaged (broken and not working normally). On November 6, 2022, representatives from 197 countries convened in Sharm el-Sheikh, Egypt, for the 2022 UN climate conference COP 27. They met to strengthen action against global warming. Each of them had their own concerns and interests, which made a huge challenge to consensus . China is the world’s biggest greenhouse gas emitter; additionally, the country is increasing its coal use to prevent energy security risks. The Chinese president said the country would try to lower carbon dioxide emissions at 2030 and achieve carbon neutrality before 2060. The United States is the world’s second biggest emitter, and its target is to reduce carbon emissions by 1 billion tons annually by 2030. The EU’s greenhouse gas emissions comprise about 8% of the global total, and they have been trending downwards for years. The EU has pledged to cut all emissions from 1990 levels by at least 55% by 2030 and then zero by 2050. Fast-developing countries like Brazil, South Africa, India, and China have highly polluting economies, and they have asked rich countries for more climate allowances. They stated that wealthy countries were historically responsible for the current problems. Difficult words: convene (to come together), consensus (a general agreement), comprise (to make up). You can watch the video news lower on this page.

On November 6, 2022, leaders of 197 countries came to Egypt for COP 27, a United Nations climate conference. The leaders discussed the difficult fight against global warming. Every country had its own problems and interests , and it was difficult to reach an agreement . The most important countries at the conference were China, the United States, and the EU. All countries promised to reduce emissions and to become carbon neutral in the future. Sadly, political situations are slowing down the changes. Brazil, South Africa, India and China are developing quickly, and their economies are growing. They asked the rich countries for financial help to fight global warming. They said that rich countries were responsible for today’s problems. Difficult words: interest (someone’s focus on something), agreement (the situation when everyone has the same opinion), carbon neutral (the creation of less carbon dioxide than from the air). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

Wars and bad feelings between countries make it difficult. Brazil, South Africa, India, and China are developing countries. Developing shows they are growing quickly. They are not very rich. These countries ask the rich countries for help. Poor countries need money for new technologies. They say that rich countries are responsible for today’s problems. The rich countries make a lot of emissions in the past. Difficult words: climate change (the changes in the world’s weather because of people’s activity), emission (gas and pollution), carbon neutral (a situation to make less gasses than to take from the air). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

After his 44-billion-dollar purchase of the social media platform, Elon Musk fired Twitter’s top executives, including the CEO, CFO, and legal affairs and policy chiefs. On Friday, Musk fired over 3,700 employees, and he blamed activist groups for a massive drop in profit. In a company-wide memo , he informed the staff that they’d receive an email at their personal accounts to say if they’d been fired. The Washington Post revealed he planned to lay off nearly 75% of Twitter’s employee base of 7,500 workers. Musk also announced he’d charge eight dollars a month to users who wanted to have a blue tick mark by their name. The tick mark indicates that their account had been verified . Some media said that Musk quickly caused chaos, and they wondered about Twitter’s future under Musk’s leadership. Difficult words: memo (a brief written message from one person to another in the same organization), lay off (to stop employing or to fire someone), verify (to confirm that something is true or accurate). You can watch the video news lower on this page.

He also sent a message to all his employees that he would fire 3,700 people, and he would send an email to each of them. Some media informed that Musk planned to sack nearly 75% of all the employees. Other news said that Twitter would charge eight dollars a month for a blue tick mark next to account names on Twitter. This tick shows that Twitter verified somebody’s account. This information surprised many people, and many wondered about more news would come. Difficult words: purchase (when a person buys something), sack (to make someone end his job), verify (to confirm that something is true or right). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

Due to record grocery costs, Americans are seeking alternatives to the traditional Thanksgiving dinner at home. Prices went up because bird flu reduced the supply of turkeys, California’s drought shrunk vegetable amounts, and few employees are working in food processing and transportation. Turkeys now cost 1.99 dollars a pound compared to 1.15 dollars a year ago. Similarly, the prices went up for potatoes by 18%, for butter by 27%, and for vegetables by 19%. According to surveys, many Americans are going to hold smaller dinners or eliminate at least one dish to save money. One in five Americans worry that they won’t have enough money for Thanksgiving. Gen Z is the most financially constrained demographic ; they are planning for soup, salad, and pizza. They’re also more willing to ask their friends to pay for their part of the feast . Difficult words: constrain (to limit or to force someone to do something), demographic (a particular part of a population), feast (a large meal for many people). You can watch the video news lower on this page.

According to surveys , one in five Americans won’t have enough money to pay for Thanksgiving dinner because it is too expensive for them. Food prices are rising due to a few reasons. A hot and dry summer in California made farmers grow less vegetables. They also killed thousands of turkeys because of bird flu. Lastly, few enough workers helped with and to transport food. These reasons are why food prices are rising. Vegetables went up 19% since last year. A pound of turkey went up to $1.99 from $1.15 since last year. Many people want to save money on this year’s Thanksgiving. Some people are planning to have a smaller dinner or to ask their guests to bring their own drinks. People in Gen Z are planning to have soup, salad, and pizza. Difficult words: survey (a study to find what people think), transport (to take things from one place to another), Gen Z (people born from 1997 to 2012). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

Other vegetables are more expensive, too. Some people say that their Thanksgiving dinner will be smaller. This situation is hard for young adults. They don’t have enough money. They say that they will eat soup, salad, and pizza for Thanksgiving. Many reasons explain why food is expensive. This year’s summer is very dry in some parts of the country. Farmers must kill thousands of turkeys. They get sick from bird flu . Also, few people are working in the food industry . Difficult words: invite (to ask someone to come somewhere), bird flu (a disease which is dangerous for chickens, turkeys, and similar animals), food industry (people and companies that make food to sell). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

Last week, Shanghai’s Disney Resort abruptly suspended work to comply with COVID-19 prevention measures. The resort management directed all visitors to stay in the park until they had negative tests for the virus. The resort shut the main theme park and surrounding areas, including its shopping street. Hundreds of visitors remained inside the park for several hours; they had to wait for their results before they could leave. The theme park continued to run rides for the visitors during the incident. The enclosure was the latest disruption for the resort; it was shut for over three months during Shanghai’s lockdown earlier this year. The park was also closed for two days in November last year with more than 30,000 visitors inside. Difficult words: abruptly (suddenly and unexpectedly), comply (to obey a rule), disruption (a situation in which something can’t continue in the normal way). You can watch the video news lower on this page.

Last week, Disney Resort in Shanghai, China, suddenly closed. Hundreds of people had to stay inside. Resort management asked all visitors to stay in the park to take a COVID-19 test. Afterward, all visitors had to wait for the results, which took several hours. In the meantime , they were allowed to go on rides. This happened twice before. In November last year, the park closed for two days with more than 30,000 visitors were inside. Earlier this year, the park closed for more than three months during the lockdown in the city. Difficult words: management (the people who control a company or organization), in the meantime (the time when something else is happening), lockdown (a situation in which people can’t freely move around an area). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

On Tuesday, SpaceX launched the first Falcon Heavy mission in over three years. It was the first operational national security mission for Falcon Heavy; it originally scheduled for late 2020. Elon Musk’s SpaceX continues to launch its Falcon series of rockets at a high rate, and the Tuesday’s mission was the company’s 50 th launch this year. The rocket lifted off from Florida’s Cape Canaveral through dense fog, and it sent a group of satellites into orbit. Tuesday’s mission was the first use of the rocket by the Space Force, a US military branch to oversee the US government’s defense activities in space. Falcon Heavy is currently the most powerful operational rocket in the world, and since its first test mission in 2018, SpaceX has launched only two other Falcon Heavy missions. One sent a large TV and phone service to satellite to orbit for Saudi Arabia, and the other delivered experimental satellites for the US Department of Defense. Difficult words: operational (relating to active operations of the army or police), defense (protection against attack), experimental (untested or not complete). You can watch the video news lower on this page.

Elon Musk’s SpaceX launched many rockets this year, but they weren’t as big as Falcon Heavy. Falcon Heavy carried satellites for the US defense system, and it was the first military mission for the rocket. The first mission took place in 2018, when Falcon Heavy carried satellites for Saudi Arabia TV and phone services. Starship is a bigger and fully reusable rocket, and SpaceX hopes to launch it into space in December this year. Difficult words: defense (keep safe from an attack), experimental (something new to test and try), reusable (something to use more than once). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

Difficult words: defense system (weapons and technology to keep a country safe from an attack), military (soldiers and army), mission (a certain job). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

Luiz Inacio Lula da Silva has become the new president of Brazil; he defeated Jair Bolsonaro with 50.9% to 49.1%. The result is a change in political direction for Latin America’s largest economy, and the government is focusing on towards the management of the Amazon rainforest. The Amazon is the world’s largest rainforest, and many call it the Earth’s lungs because it’s crucial to reduce carbon emissions. During Bolsonaro’s tenure , deforestation levels reached a 15-year high. In contrast, Lula publicly committed to over 20 environmental policies, including carbon pricing, new incentives for sustainable farming, and a committee to ensure that Brazil sticks to its environmental goals. During Lula’s previous two terms as president, the country cut deforestation in the Amazon by more than 70%. Now, Norway is ready to resume discussions on financial aid to protect the Amazon. That country stopped its collaboration along with Germany two years ago in protest to Bolsonaro’s policies. Difficult words: crucial (very important), tenure (the period of time when someone holds a job, especially an official position), incentive (something that encourages a person to do something). You can watch the video news lower on this page.

On Sunday, Luiz Inacio Lula da Silva won Brazil’s elections, and he became the new president. From 2003 to 2010, he was the previous president, and during that time, he lowered deforestation in the Amazon rainforest by 70%. In 2019, the situation changed when Jair Bolsonaro became the president. Since that time, deforestation reached the highest levels in the last 15 years. In protest, Norway and Germany stopped its financial help to Brazil, which could protect the Amazon. Lula said that he wanted to protect the Amazon and focus on sustainable farming . The Amazon is the largest rainforest in the world, and many people call it the Earth’s lungs. The rainforest is very important because it lowers carbon emissions and global warming. Difficult words: deforestation (the removal of trees in a large area), sustainable farming (farms which have little negative impact on the natural world), carbon emission (gases which planes, cars and factories make, and they hurt the natural world). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.
